title: Native forgetting preserves full acyclic-test K-flatness
statement: For a finite field k0, any prime l, and any k0-scheme X, let T be an additive native tensor bifunctor with all total complexes. Suppose chain identifies forgetting its total T(P,Q) with ordinaryTensorTotal(UP,UQ). If P is NativeTensorKFlat for T [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-presentation], then UP is NativeOrdinaryKFlat. This uses the full acyclic-test definition and imposes no termwise flatness, finite-type or boundedness hypotheses.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Define the free Frobenius induction functor using the existing explicit integer-orbit coproduct. It is additive by its adjunction. Its left adjoint preserves cokernels, and AB4 plus the orbit equivalences gives preservation of monomorphisms; hence it preserves homology.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: For an ordinary complex N construct an actual complex retract N -> U(Free N) -> N: the inclusion of orbit 0 and the projection equal to the identity at 0 and zero elsewhere. Naturality of the zero orbit proves both chain-map equations; the coproduct identities prove the retract equation.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: If N is acyclic, Free N is acyclic. Native K-flatness of P and exactness of forgetting imply that ordinaryTensorTotal(UP,U Free N) is acyclic via chain. Apply tensor with UP and then homology to the explicit retract. Its target homology is zero, so its source homology has zero identity and is zero. This proves the ordinary acyclic-test condition for every N.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_tensor_forget_kflat
    (T : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤ ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤
      ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)
    [T.Additive] [∀ P, (T.obj P).Additive]
    [∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ, P.HasMapBifunctor Q T]
    (chain : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ,
      ((IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q T) ≅
        ordinaryTensorTotal l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
          (((IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (P : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
    (hP : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X T P) :
    NativeOrdinaryKFlat l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
      (((IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P)
